title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Someone to Learn From

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Ryan emerging victorious after a white-hot spring Tenno Sho, Ines Fujin is left feeling deeply frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, instead of savoring her victory, Mejiro Ryan faces her fans and offers them her heartfelt thanks. She's the vision of a dignified racer to whom expectations are no stranger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines watches closely. Sensing that Mejiro Ryan is on another level from her, she begins to seriously consider the way she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In part to determine whether she has what it takes to reach Ryan's level, Ines decides to throw herself into training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
